section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the construct validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) by examining its correlations with various psychological measures and BMI. It reports that the BAS was positively correlated with appearance evaluation and general self-esteem, and negatively correlated with Western ideal beauty internalization, dieting, weight-related teasing, BMI, and eating disordered symptoms.
